subject: Meeting link migration and organizer affinity for MeadowBank pilot
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Green <samantha.green@meadowbank.com>, Nick O'Leary <nick.oleary@meadowbank.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Oct 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Meeting link migration and organizer affinity for MeadowBank pilot

Hi Samantha / Nick —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick follow-up: several attendees reported they couldn't join the demo when the calendar item was sent (Meet join failed with a 403). We suspect the issue is organizer affinity + MeadowBank's SSO settings that prevent external-organizer Meet entry.

Options I'd like to propose so we can keep the scheduled pilot slot (Thursday 10/23 11:00am PT):
- Temporary migration to a Zoom link we control (no org affinity), plus an ICS that we publish so your team can RSVP.
- Transfer organizer rights on the existing Meet invite to an internal account — may not be doable on short notice depending on your org's policy.
- Keep both: primary Zoom + fallback Meet link (preferred if we want to preserve the calendar origin).

Could you confirm whether MeadowBank requires SAML-enforced SSO for all external meetings? If yes, Zoom with a short-lived passcode will be simplest. I attached a screenshot of the 403 your folks saw for reference.

If I don't hear back in an hour I'll provision a Zoom as a failover and share the ICS.

Thanks,
Rishi
Sr. Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- meadowbank_meet_error.png (screenshot, 120KB stub)

From: Samantha Green <samantha.green@meadowbank.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Nick O'Leary <nick.oleary@meadowbank.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Oct 2025 09:40:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Meeting link migration and organizer affinity for MeadowBank pilot

Thanks Rishi —

We did see that 403 when several of our PMs tried to click the calendar link this morning. Attendees using their MeadowBank accounts could join other internal Meets, but any external organizer invites seem blocked by our SSO enforcement.

We definitely don't want to lose the scheduled slot on Thursday; Zoom is fine with us as long as you can provide an invite we can add to calendars. We can't transfer organizer rights on your side — our calendaring team says organizer must be within the creator domain — but a secondary Zoom link is a good workaround.

Two quick asks:
1) Can the Zoom invite include an explicit RSVP/accept so it shows up for our people?
2) Can you add a fallback Meet link in the description in case our SSO team clears it last-minute?

Appreciate it —
Samantha
Head of Integrations
MeadowBank

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Oct 2025 12:05:30 -0700
Subject: RE: Meeting link migration and organizer affinity for MeadowBank pilot

Samantha —

We can do that. Plan: I will create a Zoom meeting under our corporate account with a required passcode and enable calendar RSVP in the ICS. I'll attach the provisional ICS here (meadowbank_zoom_provision.ics) and also drop the MAP (Mutual Action Plan) so your ops leadership sees our next steps.

Technical notes / checklist:
- Zoom created with passcode + waiting room disabled for smoother join.
- ICS will include RSVP/ACCEPT semantics so attendees can add it to MeadowBank calendars.
- I'll put the current Meet link as a fallback in the Zoom description.
- After you confirm, I'll push the ICS to this thread and update the HubSpot deal record (DB-4821). HubSpot link: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/DB-4821

Provisional Zoom link (do not share externally until I publish the ICS):
https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=examplePasscode

Rishi — I need your go-ahead to publish and send the ICS to Samantha's distribution. Lauren, can you pick up the post-demo follow-up (technical checklist and SSO testing) once we have a confirmed link?

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- meadowbank_zoom_provision.ics (calendar invite stub)
- MAP_MeadowBank_Q4.pdf (Mutual Action Plan, 420KB stub)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Samantha Green <samantha.green@meadowbank.com>, Nick O'Leary <nick.oleary@meadowbank.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Oct 2025 15:32:04 -0700
Subject: Re: Meeting link migration and organizer affinity for MeadowBank pilot

Looks good — please proceed, Ben.

A couple of tiny asks before publish:
- Include the fallback Meet URL in the calendar description exactly as it appears in our original invite (so RSVP clients can preserve the link).
- Ensure the ICS RSVP shows the organizer as "Redwood Inference (demo)" so it appears on their calendars predictably.
- Add a short note in the invite description: "If your corporate SSO blocks entry, use the Zoom link above and message nick.oleary@meadowbank.com for access."

Lauren — can you pick up the SSO verification after Ben publishes, and confirm attendees can accept the invite by EOD Wednesday? If there are any hiccups we'll move the call time if needed.

Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turnaround on this.

Rishi Malhotra
Sr. Account Executive
Redwood Inference
